items.title: SafeTouch ni iki
items.body: SafeTouch ni porogaramu y'uburezi yigisha abana bafite imyaka 6 kugeza kuri 11 uko barinda umubiri wabo: umwanya bwite, gukorwaho gutekanye n'udatekanye, kuvuga OYA, n'abantu bakuru bizeye. Isomo rya 1 ryerekana ibice by'umubiri by'ibanga rikoresheje utudomo tw'amabara ku gakarito kambaye imyenda (ibice umwenda wo koga upfuka); nta na rimwe herekanwa umuntu wambaye ubusa. Isomo rya 4 ribaza umwana wawe, mu bwitonzi, niba hari umuntu utuma yumva adatekanye cyangwa ahangayitse. Ntisuzuma, ntikora iperereza kandi ntisimbura inzego zirengera abana. Niba hari umwana uhangayikishijwe na we, hamagara umurongo w'ubuntu ufasha abana 116 cyangwa ujye kuri Isange One Stop Centre.

items.title: Uko umwana wawe ayikoresha
items.body: Umwana wawe akoresha SafeTouch ari kumwe n'umuntu mukuru. Keza, umufasha, aba mu isi ye ya 3D kuri telefoni: porogaramu ntikoresha kamera na rimwe. Porogaramu ikoresha mikoro igihe umwana yitoza kuvuga OYA. Mbere y'uko mikoro ikoreshwa bwa mbere, porogaramu isobanura impamvu, hanyuma telefoni yawe ikagusaba kubyemera. Mu majwi, habikwa gusa OYA umwana wawe avuga, nk'uko bisobanuwe hepfo; nta kindi avuga kibikwa, kandi nta jwi na rimwe ryoherezwa.

items.title: Ibyo SafeTouch ibika ku mwana wawe
items.body: Kuri iyi telefoni gusa: itsinda ry'imyaka (6-8 cyangwa 9-11), iterambere mu masomo n'imidari, izina rya mbere cyangwa akazina umwana wawe aha umufasha we (ashobora kubireka), niba ahisemo umufasha w'umukobwa cyangwa w'umuhungu, uko buri OYA yavuze yari ikomeye (imibare kuva kuri 0 kugeza kuri 100, n'igihe yayivugiye), amajwi ya OYA nke umwana wawe yavuze (iya mbere, iyakomeye kurusha izindi n'umunani za nyuma, buri imwe ingana n'isegonda imwe cyangwa ebyiri, kugira ngo umwana wawe yiyumvire uko ijwi rye ryakomeye), n'ubwoko bw'abantu umwana wawe ahitamo mu isomo rya 4 (abantu bakuru yizera, n'abatuma yumva adatekanye). Amajwi abikwa mu bubiko bwihariye bwa porogaramu kuri iyi telefoni: ntiyoherezwa na rimwe, habe no mu kohereza amakuru. Ushobora kuyumva cyangwa kuyasiba muri Ababyeyi > Umwana wanjye, no guhagarika kuyafata muri Ababyeyi > Igenamiterere (icyo gihe hasigara imibare gusa). Ntizigera ibika ifoto y'umwana wawe cyangwa aho aherereye, ikindi kintu cyose umwana wawe avuga, cyangwa amazina y'abantu ahitamo. Ibisubizo bye ubibona muri Ababyeyi > Umwana wanjye. Niba umuntu mukuru afunguye kohereza amakuru atagaragaza umwana mu Igenamiterere, ibisubizo by'amasomo byoherezwa n'inomero idasanzwe ya telefoni; izina n'igisubizo cyerekeye abatuma yumva adatekanye ntibigera byoherezwa.

items.title: Ibyo SafeTouch ibika kuri wowe
items.body: Izina ryawe, nimero ya telefoni, aderesi ya imeyili n'igihugu, n'itariki wemereyeho. Bikoreshwa gusa mu kwemeza uru ruhushya (tukoherereza kode y'imibare 6 n'ingero y'ibyo wemeye kuri imeyili) no kukuvugisha kuri rwo. Bibikwa kuri seriveri ya SafeTouch, bitandukanye n'iterambere ry'umwana wawe, kandi ntibigurishwa cyangwa ngo bihabwe abandi.

items.title: Uburenganzira bwawe
items.body: Ushobora gukuraho uruhushya rwawe igihe icyo ari cyo cyose muri Ababyeyi > Igenamiterere > Kuraho uruhushya. Ibi bisiba amakuru yawe kuri seriveri, iterambere ry'umwana wawe kuri iyi telefoni no kuri seriveri, n'amajwi ya OYA kuri iyi telefoni. Ushobora gusaba kureba cyangwa gukosora amakuru yawe. Hakurikijwe Itegeko N° 058/2021 ryerekeye kurinda amakuru bwite n'ibanga ryayo mu Rwanda, umubyeyi cyangwa umurera wemewe n'amategeko ni we utanga uruhushya ku mwana uri munsi y'imyaka 16.

items.title: Ubushakashatsi bwa SafeTouch
items.body: SafeTouch ni igice cy'umushinga w'ubushakashatsi wo gusoza amasomo muri African Leadership University. Kwitabira ni ubushake, kandi kwanga cyangwa guhagarara nyuma nta ngaruka bigira kuri wowe cyangwa ku mwana wawe.
